notes.title: HUGE UPDATE! LAYERS! GROUPS! WORKSHOP SUPPORT! REWORKED PAINTING!
notes.notes:
Sorry for such a long wait between updates, its been in pieces and connected to workshop which wouldn't have worked in public builds for quite a while
And i didn't have the energy to maintain two branches so i just doubled down on grinding this out

But here we finally are

Version 4.0 and nearly 15k installs

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/ead4fa8fd26d23eddeac7b0707a75ac973912bcf.png[/img]

We have come such a long way

I cant thank everyone enough, it genuinely means the world to me to see people using it every day

But anyway patch notes!

[h1]------Reworked Painting------[/h1]

You can still paint with the main brush as you could before, but at low resolutions the other brushes didnt have enough character to warrant use
So now ive moved things to a more tileable pattern system

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/15f1a442ee02c7fc61d404b176063a3aa7d563c0.gif[/img]

Works far more flexible
Makes stuff like painting bricks on a wall and then vines on that wall so much easier

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/14f880391b25d2878fb5f8f946a83ca6121fa436.gif[/img]

Swap between Object and view mode to shift projection models

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/164687d516a8103d687bdd9d66b0378ef5486641.gif[/img]

[h1]------Layers------[/h1]
Can now paint in layers with unique palettes on each layer
Great for adding blood on a monster, or vines on a wall
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/7dd77b09be0bfba2e1de47d73391c2f02b96b651.gif[/img]

[h1]------OBJ Groups------[/h1]
Can now import obj groups, this helps a lot with separating big scenes up into walls / floors / pillars etc, or a gun into its different components, or having the head on a player character separate from the body so theres no texture leak over to the shirt below or the hair for example
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/be0d7e53fbb6d7f236151f3235496f1959e5d817.gif[/img]

[h1]------Improved Downsampling------[/h1]
Now updates automatically and edge buffer now works as it should
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/bbd42100e03e0eebd752bb2ee6c46105624a4ddc.gif[/img]
The gif above also shows the turntable, just press space for it to give you a spin, and space again to stop

[h1]------Transparency------[/h1]
Paint with transparency onto models, great for holes and details, wonderful for cloth and folliage
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/4e21f7bc29a8281a06cca171655705cc9866003d.gif[/img]

[h1]------Workshop Support------[/h1]
Subscribe to any brushes you like the look of here
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1976160/workshop/
And theyll be downloaded next time you open the app

To upload a brush to the workshop there should be a new "tool" in your steam library
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/2b622bcea731a5ce77c9a3c0acd245c16a49b432.png[/img]
You will need to accept the tos before itll let you upload https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/workshoplegalagreement/
But it should prompt you and open a browser to that site automatically

Once you have done that its as simple as typing in a name for the brush, browsing to the image you wish to use and clicking upload
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/0d64c1943715903ac9941912c96c36c4203cd637.png[/img]


[h1]------Music player------[/h1]
Was a bit nervous about adding this 
But 1 button to turn off and skip
And i think it adds a lot to the ambiance
Just out here vibing, picking some colors, using them colors on a model or reference image
Feels different with chill music
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/8e3604b1e67c4827c4fff793ff6b883a4aea3736.png[/img]


[h1]------Widescreen Support------[/h1]
Not completely tested, but it should work better now, pls let me know if theres any screens that dont fit everything on, and ill have a fiddle
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/649c571df8b13fd883fdb102b43ee678b1f8f660.png[/img]

[h1]------Closing notes------[/h1]
Ive tried my best to test and make sure its stable, but a lot has changed this patch, so i apologise in advance if anything's a bit wobbly
And theres a lot of moving parts so there probably will be some wobbles
Just let me know in the forums and ill try fix anything that does pop up as its found

Guides will be out of date for a little while, but ill be editing them and adding new ones to help with workshop support shortly

Also id love to see what any of you are all working on, if you have anything you wish to share please consider using https://twitter.com/hashtag/PixelPaletteCreator so its easy to find, i dont have a ton of followers on there but ill be retweeting anything i notice that pops up as long as its not illegal or lewd 

Thanks again, Jofer

notes.title: HUGE UPDATE! 3D PAINTING! COMPLETE OVERHAUL!
notes.notes:
This was meant to be a thank you for 10k downloads update, but I got carried away, and now we are nearly at 12.5k, and im completely blown away by people actually using this, I expected this to be mainly a tool that only I used, and it genuinely means the world to me that other people are out there using it too so I really tried to make this update special.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/4f5c23cd77e5bc41e40c7a9148148fb8aec40632.png[/img]

The first thing that should be immediately noticeable is theres a complete ui overhaul, no more whacky psychedelic backgrounds, or bricks on every page, im not the best at ui design, but hopefully people will find this a lot cleaner and hopefully more appealing.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/bcbc2fd28dc51efea1b22fe21a37c8260a2941ea.gif[/img]

But the bulk of the work for the new update was on the new 3d stuff
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/f48616118ff6bfb95f52deea99d64bff806c4847.gif[/img]

You can now use 3d models in the same way you have been able to use reference images to map your colors directly, and import and export how you did before 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/837c331c8c6b3860ca407c5f2f890bf20388c49c.gif[/img]

But now you can paint directly onto the models, using whatever brushes you like, you can import your own brushes, edit the existing brushes, approach it however you like
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/2534732ce16b7d376bc9c9c0f4c615019c39e64e.gif[/img]

Also I think people might have been having problems with the drag n drop hooks not activating on everyone's machines, so I added an option in the settings to manually load images and objs.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/dbf5f71af19d326faf1041df469bd0c3057c3006.gif[/img]

A lot has changed in this build, so there might be bugs or wonky behaviours, ill be using it too so hopefully ill notice if there is anything wrong, but if anyone notices anything itd help a ton if you dropped a comment in the thread to let me know what to look at.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/1976160/discussions/0/3424438414127401765/

Ill be going to bed shortly after I post this update, but when I wake up ill be working on better tutorializing the new features, so if you feel a little lost with how anything works hopefully I can help with that in the morning :)

Tried to summarise the new stuff in the trailer, so if your interested it might explain things better then I have here :) 
[previewyoutube=ub5SmyxJHjk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Reference Images, Pick 5 and Node Ordering
notes.notes:
Quite a lot of new stuff today

Scenes now open with a reference image (that defaults to a gradient)

And the nodes are now held ordered (by x position) instead of random dictionary access position

So now its easier to know what your exporting before you export it

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/26410a0d61c1a6c7252bd9a24be3372eba85a7cd.gif[/img]

You can also replace the gradient with any other image to get a better feel for how the palette looks in practice without having to manually draw in the test section

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/c9aad7e24e5bfebc6b03582d98dbef53fcf149db.gif[/img]

And if you want to work from larger art pieces or lossier formats like jpgs

You can now import the 5 most prominent colors from the image, instead of all of the colors

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42338613/cc9988311740cfe3857fe3129e7a6d90008ad5ac.gif[/img]

Hope this improves things a little

If anyone has any thing else theyd like adding, or if anyone finds any bugs, please continue to let me know and we can hopefully keep this working towards being something cool :)
